Vinod Kumar Marely Anaplan Developer

9177912378

connectvinodkm1991@gmail.com

SUMMARY

Total IT experience of 7 years, including 2.7 years of hands-on experience in Anaplan Design, build, and maintain Anaplan models for business functions such as Sales Planning, FP&A, Supply Chain, and HR. Create modules, line items, lists, hierarchies, and dimensions according to business requirements. Implement complex formulas, allocations, and calculations to meet business logic needs. Optimize model performance by reducing sparsity, improving calculation speed, and managing time hierarchies. Manage data imports, exports, and data hubs for consistent master data. Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure accuracy. Build interactive dashboards (Anaplan UX) for management and stakeholders. Applied ALM for version control, module synchronization, and deployment from Dev → Test → Production. Follow DISCO methodology (Design, Implement, Support, Control, Optimize). Implement enhancements to models, dashboards, and calculations as per evolving business needs. Developed and integrated custom actions using PowerShell, PSADT, VBScript, Wise Script, and Batch scripting to support complex installation logic. Implemented major, minor, and small updates/upgrades, including rollback, self-healing, and self- repair mechanisms. Performed comprehensive MSI validation and quality assurance using AdminStudio and Wise Package Studio to ensure reliability and standardization. Created and deployed silent installation and uninstallation packages using command-line parameters and scripting best practices.

EDUCATION

Master of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad

SKILL

Anaplan Model Building ALM Testing PowerShell

DISCO Methodology Data Hub creation PLANS

SNOW Ticketing Tool,

dashboard development UX Design Modules VMWare

CERTIFICATIONS

The Anaplan Way Anaplan Certification in L1 Anaplan Certification in L2 Anaplan Certification in L3

WORK EXPERIENCE

Working as a Senior Engineer in LTI Mindtree (Mindtree) Ltd, Hyderabad from June 2021 to till date Worked as a Senior Software Engineer in Tech Mahindra Ltd- Hyderabad from April 2019 to Aug 2020. Worked as a Software Engineer in Wipro Ltd - Bangalore from May 2018 to Mar 2019.

2016

PROFESSIONAL WORK EXPERIENCE

Project :1 Anaplan Developer Implementation

August 2024 to Till Date

Implemented an end-to-end Sales Planning solution in Anaplan for managing sales forecasts, quota allocation, and territory planning. Enabled real-time visibility into sales performance and pipeline for leadership and regional managers.

Designed and built modules for sales forecasting, quota allocation, and pipeline tracking Developed dashboards (UX pages) for sales performance monitoring and KPIs Created hierarchies for regions, products, and sales reps Built calculation logic using formulas, line items, and lists Optimized model performance (reduced sparsity, improved calculation time) Collaborated with sales stakeholders to gather and translate requirements Performed unit testing, UAT support, and deployment activities Maintained role-based access control and security settings Provided production support and issue resolution Create modules, line items, lists, hierarchies, and dimensions as per business requirements. Implement complex formulas, allocations, and calculations to support business logic.

Project : 2 Anaplan Developer Implementation

July 2023 to August 2024

Provided ongoing support and implemented enhancements for an FP&A Anaplan model used for budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. Ensured data accuracy, system stability, and improved usability for finance teams.

Provided production support by resolving user-reported issues and system errors. Performed data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting to ensure accurate financial

reporting.

mplemented enhancements to existing models, including new modules, line items, and

calculations.

Optimized forecasting and budgeting models for performance and usability. Updated dashboards and reports to reflect new business requirements and KPIs. Managed role-based access and security settings for multiple user groups. Applied ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) for seamless deployment of enhancements. Collaborated with finance stakeholders to understand requirements and implement business

process improvements.

Ensured adherence to DISCO methodology and PLANS standards for scalable and maintainable

models.

Conducted UAT (User Acceptance Testing) for all enhancements before production release.

Project: 3 Senior Engineer

June 2021 to August 2023

I’m responsible to maintain the application end to end, which includes approving access to users, customizing the product, planning deployment to test group and production, discuss with vendor for any upgradation, suggesting and providing solution to customer to have their application in the environment in most secured, stable and cost-effective manner.

Performed comprehensive analysis of setup.exe–based installers, including dependency validation, install/uninstall behaviour, and verification of DSNs, drivers, services, registry entries, per-user data, shortcuts, and application artifacts.

Conducted peer QA and verification reviews for application packages to ensure adherence to enterprise

and client packaging standards.

Troubleshot complex application packaging and deployment issues by reviewing source media, installer

logic, logs, and package configurations.

Provided technical recommendations and client concessions for business-critical applications deviating

from standard packaging guidelines.

Maintained centralized application inventory, tracking clarifications, exceptions, concessions, and audit- ready documentation. Served as a key BAU resource, supporting team leads in managing daily EUC and application operations. Delivered end-to-end EUC support including Windows patching, application deployment, and endpoint maintenance for ~10,000 devices. Executed monthly Windows patching using Kaseya VSA 9, ensuring SLA compliance and high patch success rates. Managed application deployments using OU-based collections and targeted delivery strategies.

April 2019 to Aug 2020

Project : 4 Software Engineer

Worked on enterprise application packaging and deployment using MSI, MST, and EXE formats, ensuring compliance with organizational standards. Created and remediated packages using InstallShield, PSADT, VBScript, and App-V, and deployed applications via SCCM across Windows 10, and Server environments. Performed extensive QA/UAT testing, troubleshooting, and documentation to deliver stable, production- ready application releases.

Designed and packaged applications using MSI, MST, and EXE formats in compliance with enterprise

application packaging standards.

Created MSI packages for legacy applications and MST transforms for vendor-supplied MSIs using

InstallShield and Wise Script Editor.

Performed silent installations and uninstallations using command-line switches, VBScript, and PSADT

(PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit).

Captured legacy applications using InstallShield Setup Capture to analyze pre-install and post-install

system changes.

Developed and managed application upgrades to support version control and backward compatibility. Built and deployed App-V 5.0 and App-V 5.1 packages for virtualized application delivery across Windows

environments.

Utilized diagnostic and packaging tools including ORCA, InstallRite, Process Monitor (ProcMon) and

Beyond Compare.

Tested application packages across Windows 7, Windows 10, and Windows Server OS Platforms. Deployed applications to QA, UAT, and Production environments using SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint

Configuration Manager).

Project : 5 Software Engineer

May 2018 to Mar 2019.

Our companies are engaged in Structures & Logistics (workforce housing, innovative modular facilities, construction, site support services, and logistics and operations management); Electricity (electricity generation, transmission, and distribution); Pipelines & Liquids (natural gas transmission, distribution and infrastructure development, energy storage, and industrial water solutions); and Retail Energy (electricity and natural gas retail sales).

Tested packages on Win 7 & Win 10 OS environments. Used third party tools ORCA, Install Rite as part of troubleshooting.
